parameters.query: select table_name,description from TAP_SCHEMA.tables where (description like '%GALAH%' or description like '%APOGEE%' or description like '%TESS-HERMES%') and (description like '%binary%' or description like '%Binary%' or description like '%binaries%' or description like '%Binaries%' or description like '%double-lined%' or description like '%ouble-Lined%' or description like '%double-star%' or description like '%SB2%' or description like '%Joker%')
